stages.stage: G1 exhaustive robust search + iterative adversarial scenario
G2 screening set for strategic analysis
G2 robust optimization + iterative adversarial scenario

scenario_descriptions.balanced: Mostly equal-split and near-equal intuitive allocations.
scenario_descriptions.proportional: Mostly allocations proportional to castle value, with noise and rounding.
scenario_descriptions.concentrated: Mostly players who concentrate on a few castles (high, middle or low).
scenario_descriptions.strategic: Mostly computationally optimized players (best responses and self-play outputs).
scenario_descriptions.broad_mixture: A broad mix of every family; the stated default mixture for averaging.
scenario_descriptions.adversarial: Half best responses targeting the candidate finalists, plus strategic and simple players.
